svg.title: The case record, not a league table
svg.desc: A domain-by-class matrix lists every RB case, its ledger lag or an unknown marker, weak-source flags and a mark for the kind of evidence, with an index of case titles.
svg.text: The case record, not a league table
31 ledger cases by domain and latency class. Each case appears once in every class it is assigned; the marks give the kind of evidence, not a score.

case ledger gives the anchors, qualifications, and sources for each entry.
